Stefani initially disagreed with Williams' choice to use direct references to Paddington in the lyrics, but praised this decision after watching the film with her children.  She reported that her involvement with the recording was inspired by her then-husband Gavin Rossdale and her children's connection to England.
Back to the Primitive | "Back to the Primitive" is a nu metal song by Soulfly, released in 2000.  The song, composed by Max Cavalera, is played as the first track of the second Soulfly album, "Primitive".
